انتقعتن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَقَعْتُنَّ (intaqaʕtunna) /in.ta.qaʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# اُنْتُقِعْتُنَّ (untuqiʕtunna) /un.tu.qiʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
